items.difficulty_reason: Ass_B(omega_{B/A}) is the fibre over Ass(A) for quasi-finite maps: reduces to the finite case by the factorization and base-change compatibilities, forward direction constructs the A-linear map B -> A via a kappa(p)-linear lambda scaled into A/p by an f in A - p (annihilator check author-marked easy), converse localizes at p and uses a nonzerodivisor f in m acting nonzerodivisibly on omega. Retained author proof at lines 515-552.
